title: Sheets rows → Slack digest
h1: Post new Google Sheets rows to Slack as one digest
opsNote: Make charges one operation per module per bundle, so a cycle that picks up N new rows costs 2N + 1: N for the Google Sheets Watch New Rows trigger, N for the Text aggregator that consumes those N bundles, and 1 for the single Slack Send a Message. opsPerRun 21 is the worked example of N = 10. The trigger Limit ships at 25, so the worst case for one cycle is 51. No AI module: google-sheets, util and slack all report premium: false and centicreditsFormula: null in the Make app catalog, so no credits are consumed. Counted from the module list, not yet measured on a paid run.

faq.q: Does this work on the free plan?
faq.a: Yes. Three standard modules, two connections, no premium apps and no AI credits. The free plan checks the sheet every 15 minutes, so you get at most four digests an hour.

faq.q: Why are the modules red after import?
faq.a: Accounts never travel inside a blueprint. Open each red module, pick or create the account, and the red disappears.

faq.q: Can I get one Slack message per row instead of a digest?
faq.a: Yes. Delete step 2 and drag step 3 onto the trigger. Every new row then posts its own message, and a cycle of 10 rows costs 20 operations instead of 21.

faq.q: How many rows fit in one digest?
faq.a: Up to the Limit set on the trigger, which ships at 25. Rows above that wait for the next cycle.
